t: This one is a little different, because SchoolOfNewAfrica is a mobile app and an organisation rather than a building you can see. It is owned by Fuse ODG, the Ghanaian-English singer, songwriter and rapper, whose real name is Nana Richard Abiona. He first came to attention with the Top-10 hit Antenna, followed by Dangerous Love. He also featured on Major Lazer's Light It Up remix, which reached number 73 on the US Billboard Hot 100 in 2016.
